name: @w6w-apps/recruit-crm
description: Search and manage Recruit CRM candidates, companies, contacts and jobs, assign candidates to jobs and move them through hiring stages.

w6w.longDescription:
Recruit CRM is an applicant tracking system and CRM for recruitment agencies. This app connects a workflow to a Recruit CRM account so candidate, client and job data can flow between the ATS and the rest of the stack.

Search and read candidates, companies, contacts and jobs; create candidates, companies and contacts as leads arrive from forms or sourcing tools; assign a candidate to a job and move them through the hiring pipeline; and attach notes to any record.

Connect with the account's API token from Admin Settings.
